name: NVIDIA Quadro RTX 8000 (Turing, 48 GB)
memory_bandwidth_basis: Datasheet prints 'Memory Bandwidth 672 GB/s', 'Memory Interface 384-bit', 'GPU Memory 48 GB GDDR6'. Same bandwidth as the Quadro RTX 6000; only capacity doubles.

flops.basis_detail: Datasheet 'Single-Precision Performance 16.3 TFLOPS'. Same TU102 config as the Quadro RTX 6000 (4608 CUDA cores), so the number is identical and dense:true.

notes: USED-MARKET 48 GB CARD. Same 4608 CUDA / 576 Tensor / 72 RT core TU102 as the Quadro RTX 6000 with memory doubled to 48 GB and board power raised to 295 W (total graphics power 260 W). NVLink HB bridge quoted at 100 GB/s bidirectional for 96 GB combined, application support required. Bandwidth is the trap: 672 GB/s is well under the RTX A6000 (768 GB/s) and RTX 6000 Ada (960 GB/s), so a cheap 48 GB listing is not an A6000. ECC, active dual-slot, PCIe 3.0 x16.
